content.short: Hologram is an all-in-one platform for virtual avatars.
content.description: Hologram animates NFTs by upgrading the brands and IPs of holders and communities, making them usable across social, content, and gaming environments. Its creation platform enables artists to design high-fidelity virtual avatars, fashion assets, and more at scale, expanding the scope of NFT-driven expression. The platform also offers consumer apps that let NFT holders and other users socialize, create content, or livestream as motion-tracked virtual characters across compatible channels and experiences.
